programs.name: Changing biological age
programs.objective: A specified organ/function outcome with independent molecular measures, adverse effects and persistence.
programs.starting_point: Organ signatures and aging-clock results measure different outcomes; they are not interchangeable causal surrogates.
programs.first_question: Which organ, functional deficit and retained systemic benefits define success?
programs.if_supported: Prespecify a functional endpoint and independent molecular endpoint for the declared organ.
programs.if_not_supported: Keep the analysis exploratory; a clock shift cannot supply the missing benefit definition.
programs.invalid_shortcut: A lower clock age, SenMayo score or model probability establishes rejuvenation.

programs.name: SLU-PP-915 oral improvement
programs.objective: More reproducible intact active-parent exposure with retained ERR activity and intended function.
programs.starting_point: Mouse oral activity exists; identified products include enzyme-blank products, without human pathway-rate attribution.
programs.first_question: Is parent loss chemical, enzyme-dependent, dissolution-related, or an analytical recovery problem?
programs.if_supported: Choose a comparison specific to the established limiting process; retain parent/product resolution and ERR isoform response.
programs.if_not_supported: Resolve parent recovery and stability before selecting a new substitution or precursor.
requirements: ERR EC50 and maximal response kept separate
programs.invalid_shortcut: Microsomal stability, reduced TPSA or an ester label establishes improved human oral exposure.

programs.name: SS-31 oral delivery
programs.objective: Systemic intact peptide after oral delivery with retained useful mitochondrial function.
programs.starting_point: Reference membrane/cell comparators exist; patents predict oral changes. Animal exposure can fail to translate, as SBT-272 sponsor disclosure illustrates.
programs.first_question: Does the delivery change increase usable intact-peptide exposure while preserving function?
programs.if_supported: Separate exposure, mitochondrial access and functional response, with source-specific route references.
programs.if_not_supported: Compare unchanged-parent delivery with the analog; increased carrier or total-peptide signal cannot establish success.
requirements: oral exposure with a suitable route reference
programs.invalid_shortcut: Patent prediction or membrane affinity establishes an orally effective human peptide.

programs.name: SS-31 duration
programs.objective: Preserved useful intracellular exposure or longer functional persistence without losing activity.
programs.starting_point: Human plasma stability and human systemic residence are different experiments; protease resistance alone is not a duration solution.
programs.first_question: Is clearance, cell access or persistence of function the limiting property?
programs.if_supported: Use a mechanism-specific duration comparison and check retained function at interpretable exposure.
programs.if_not_supported: Measure relevant elimination and function before assuming a terminal inversion or conjugation fixes duration.
requirements: persistence of function after exposure falls
programs.invalid_shortcut: Longer plasma half-life or total albumin-associated signal guarantees a longer useful effect.

programs.name: SS-31 manufacturing cost
programs.objective: Lower manufacturing burden for an equivalently specified material, with acceptable impurities and retained function.
programs.starting_point: An unchanged-parent process patent and a published Tyr comparator provide different comparisons; neither establishes actual savings.
programs.first_question: Which process step drives measured material and purification burden for parent?
programs.if_supported: Compare unchanged-parent process alternatives with yield, impurity and stability accounting before sequence substitution.
programs.if_not_supported: Gather process economics; residue names and nominal step count cannot establish a cheaper equivalent product.
programs.invalid_shortcut: Replacing Dmt with Tyr proves cheaper, interchangeable SS-31.

programs.name: MOTS-c oral development
programs.objective: Intact active species with retained relevant target, cellular and organ responses after oral delivery.
programs.starting_point: CK2 and tissue-specific response assays exist; K14Q shows that slower reported clearance can coexist with weaker function.
programs.first_question: Does a defined change retain relevant function and trafficking independently of immunoreactive persistence?
programs.if_supported: Assess intact exposure and oral delivery while keeping target engagement, trafficking and tissue responses separate.
programs.if_not_supported: Retain parent as the delivery comparator; do not advance a persistent but functionally altered peptide as an upgrade.
requirements: oral outcome kept separate from injected trial records
programs.invalid_shortcut: Higher ELISA signal, CK2 affinity alone, or a CB4211 registry entry establishes oral native-MOTS-c benefit.

programs.name: Acetylated Epitalon oral development
programs.objective: A specified capped material with reproducible relevant function and measured intact-species exposure.
programs.starting_point: Parent cell-line telomere findings and public structure references exist; no capped-versus-parent improvement was established in the reviewed sources.
programs.first_question: Which parent-relative functional effect remains after each single cap?
programs.if_supported: Evaluate intact exposure and delivery for that declared effect with separate safety endpoints.
programs.if_not_supported: Resolve identity and useful function before an oral optimization campaign.
requirements: free acid versus C-terminal amide versus salt identity
telomere and safety outcomes kept separate
programs.invalid_shortcut: Capping, smaller peptide size or telomere lengthening establishes human rejuvenation.

programs.name: Caffeine off-switch
programs.objective: Sustained reduction of relevant stimulant activity after systemic distribution, followed by a separate sleep outcome.
programs.starting_point: Aqueous hosts, aptamers and bacterial conversion exist; the reviewed evidence does not establish an oral human reversal molecule.
programs.first_question: Does recognition survive physiological competition and cover relevant active metabolites?
programs.if_supported: Resolve intact-host systemic availability, brain redistribution and capture/product disposition before sleep reversal claims.
programs.if_not_supported: Redesign recognition/coverage; stronger water binding or greater capacity alone is insufficient.
requirements: physiological free-ligand capture or characterized conversion
oral systemic availability and sustained removal
central response and independent human sleep endpoint
programs.invalid_shortcut: Buffer affinity, a sensor detection limit, caffeine disappearance or a competing antagonist establishes normal sleep.

programs.name: Other stimulant or peptide reversal
programs.objective: Reversal for one declared ligand/mechanism in its relevant compartment.
programs.starting_point: Ligand-specific molecular-container and protein-binder precedents exist; they do not create a universal off-switch.
programs.first_question: Which exact stimulant, active metabolites and central/peripheral mechanism must be reversed?
programs.if_supported: Compare capture, receptor antagonism and catalytic degradation using mechanism-specific endpoints.
programs.if_not_supported: Specify the ligand and compartment; molecular size alone cannot rank reversal difficulty.
programs.invalid_shortcut: Peptide size or one successful host/binder implies easy reversal of another stimulant.

programs.name: Rapamycin reproductive selectivity
programs.objective: Retained target-organ benefit with less relevant testicular pathway suppression and improved direct reproductive endpoints.
programs.starting_point: Complex-selective and tissue-restricted approaches exist; their reviewed results do not establish testicular protection.
programs.first_question: Which target-organ benefit must be retained, at a matched target response?
programs.if_supported: Compare free exposure/pathway responses in relevant testicular compartments, then reproductive outcomes.
programs.if_not_supported: Define retained benefit before selecting an organ-restricted strategy; systemic and local objectives differ.
requirements: direct sperm, endocrine and reproductive outcomes
programs.invalid_shortcut: mTORC2 sparing, lower total testis concentration or brain exclusion proves reproductive safety.
